summaries.summary: DevicesMFE is a page object class that extends SmartFlow and provides automation methods for interacting with the HP Smart Devices MFE (Micro Frontend) interface. It includes verification flows for validating UI elements such as popups, navigation bars, device cards, and status sections, as well as action flows for clicking buttons, refreshing pages, and interacting with device elements. The class also contains methods for handling the HPX What's New popup workflow, including navigation through multiple screens and retrieving text content.
